review: The hymn is the peace that outlasts care: 1:1–4 is John 14:27 with Phil 4:7, 2:1–4 is Ps 94:19 with Ps 119:7, 3:1–4 is Heb 2:18 with Heb 7:25, and 4:1–4 is Ps 42:10 with Luke 21:28.

The print breaks two words across the line-break (صُعُو / بَاتٍ and سَيَجِي / ـآ), and the Hebrew mirrors the enjambment at the same seams (עַל־ at the end of 4:1, the verb at the end of 4:3) rather than moving the words to make tidy lines.

1:1–2 keep the split between the Lord's act and the gift (נָתַן … אֶת־הַשָּׁלוֹם), because the Arabic حَبَا / نِي splits the same verb across the stanza's first two lines and the payload does not mend it.
